name: Barbell Back Squat
description: A back-loaded squat combining knee and hip extension.
instructions: Set rack safeties, position the bar on the upper back, and brace. Bend the hips and knees to a controlled depth, keeping the feet planted, then stand without losing trunk position.

name: High-Bar Back Squat
description: A back squat with the bar supported high on the upper trapezius.
instructions: Place the bar on the upper traps rather than the neck. Brace, descend between the hips with the knees following the toes, and rise while maintaining pressure through the whole foot.

name: Low-Bar Back Squat
description: A back squat with the bar supported lower across the rear shoulders.
instructions: Secure the bar across the rear-deltoid shelf and brace. Allow the torso angle needed to keep the bar over the feet, descend under control, and drive the hips and chest upward together.

name: Front Squat
description: A front-loaded barbell squat with the bar supported across the front shoulders.
instructions: Establish a secure front rack with the elbows pointing forward. Brace, squat to a depth you can control without losing the rack, and stand while keeping the bar supported on the shoulders.

name: Safety Bar Squat
description: A squat performed with a padded safety squat bar and forward-facing handles.
instructions: Position the yoke on the upper back and hold the handles lightly. Brace, squat with steady foot pressure, and stand without pulling the handles hard enough to change the bar position.

name: Box Squat
description: A squat that uses a box as a controlled bottom position.
instructions: Set a stable box to the prescribed height and use rack safeties. Lower onto the box without dropping or rocking, retain trunk tension, and stand from the settled position.

name: Safety Bar Box Squat
description: A box squat using a safety squat bar.
instructions: Set the box and safeties, secure the padded yoke, and brace. Settle onto the box under control without relaxing the back, then stand without rocking or yanking the handles.

name: Hatfield Squat
description: A safety bar squat performed while holding fixed supports for assistance and balance.
instructions: Set a safety bar securely and grasp stable rack handles. Squat with the torso supported by the handhold, then extend the hips and knees while maintaining the prescribed level of arm assistance.

name: Zercher Squat
description: A squat with a barbell held in the crooks of the elbows.
instructions: Lift the bar from an appropriate rack height into the elbow creases. Keep the load close, brace, descend between the hips, and stand without allowing the upper back to collapse.

name: Goblet Squat
description: A squat holding one dumbbell or kettlebell in front of the chest.
instructions: Hold the weight close to the chest and set a comfortable stance. Descend while keeping the feet grounded and the torso controlled, then push the floor away to stand.

name: Dumbbell Front Squat
description: A squat holding two dumbbells at shoulder level.
instructions: Bring the dumbbells to the shoulders and brace. Squat between the hips without letting the weights drift forward, then stand while keeping the torso and knees controlled.

name: Double Kettlebell Front Squat
description: A squat performed with two kettlebells held in the front-rack position.
instructions: Rack both bells against the forearms and upper arms. Brace, lower into the squat while keeping the bells close, and stand without allowing the trunk to tip or the wrists to fold back.

name: Landmine Squat
description: A front-loaded squat holding the end of an anchored barbell.
instructions: Secure the landmine pivot and hold the sleeve near the chest. Find a stance that follows the bar's arc, squat with planted feet, and stand while keeping the load close.

name: Overhead Squat
description: A squat performed while stabilizing a bar overhead.
instructions: Use a light, controllable load and establish a stable overhead position. Descend without letting the bar drift outside the base of support, then stand while keeping the elbows extended.

name: Pause Squat
description: A back squat with a deliberate pause at the bottom.
instructions: Descend with a braced trunk, pause at the prescribed depth without relaxing or bouncing, and drive upward. Keep the pause duration and depth consistent with the training prescription.

name: Paused Front Squat
description: A front squat with a deliberate pause in the receiving position.
instructions: Keep the bar supported in the front rack as you descend. Pause at the assigned depth with the trunk braced, then stand without letting the elbows fall.

name: Pin Squat
description: A squat that settles the bar on rack safeties before the ascent.
instructions: Set both safeties evenly at the prescribed depth. Lower the bar onto them under control, retain your brace, and stand from a complete stop without bouncing the bar.

name: Anderson Squat
description: A bottom-up squat beginning with the bar resting on rack safeties.
instructions: Set the bar on pins at a height from which you can establish a stable squat position. Brace before taking the load, stand from the pins, and return the bar evenly under control.

name: Heels-Elevated Goblet Squat
description: A goblet squat with the heels supported on a stable wedge.
instructions: Place both heels on a secure wedge and hold the weight at the chest. Let the knees travel naturally as you descend, keep the feet supported, and rise without losing balance.

name: Cyclist Squat
description: A narrow-stance squat with elevated heels that emphasizes knee extension.
instructions: Use a stable heel wedge and a stance you can control. Keep the torso relatively upright, lower through the knees and hips, and stand without bouncing or forcing a painful range.

name: Bodyweight Squat
description: An unloaded squat used for lower-body training or movement practice.
instructions: Stand in a comfortable stance, bend the hips and knees, and lower between the legs. Keep the feet grounded, then return to standing without collapsing the knees inward.

name: Squat to Box
description: An unloaded squat using a box or bench as a depth reference.
instructions: Stand in front of a stable box, reach the hips back as the knees bend, and touch the box gently. Stand without dropping onto the seat or pushing excessively with the hands.

name: Wall Sit
description: An isometric squat hold with the back supported against a wall.
instructions: Slide down a wall to the prescribed knee angle with the feet positioned for support. Hold the position while breathing steadily, then slide up to finish without pushing through sharp pain.

name: Spanish Squat
description: A squat supported by a securely anchored strap or heavy band behind the knees.
instructions: Place the strap behind both knees and lean back enough to tension it. Sit down with a relatively upright torso, then stand while keeping the strap secure and the feet planted.

name: Sissy Squat
description: A knee-dominant squat performed with the hips relatively extended.
instructions: Hold a stable support and rise onto the forefeet if needed. Let the knees move forward as the body leans back as a unit, then extend the knees through a range you can control.

name: Split Squat
description: A stationary split-stance squat loading primarily the front leg.
instructions: Set a long enough split stance to remain balanced. Lower the body by bending both knees, keep the front foot grounded, and drive through the front leg to rise.

name: Dumbbell Split Squat
description: A split squat holding dumbbells alongside the body.
instructions: Hold the dumbbells at the sides and establish a stable split stance. Lower the rear knee toward the floor, then stand through the front leg without pushing sideways or losing balance.

name: Barbell Split Squat
description: A split squat with a barbell across the upper back.
instructions: Use a rack to position the bar and set a stable split stance. Lower under control with the trunk braced, then extend the front hip and knee to return upright.

name: Bulgarian Split Squat
description: A rear-foot-elevated split squat using a bench or support.
instructions: Rest the rear foot on a stable support and place the front foot far enough forward for balance. Lower through the front leg, then stand without using the rear leg to launch upward.

name: Front-Foot-Elevated Split Squat
description: A split squat with the working front foot raised to allow a larger available range.
instructions: Place the front foot on a low, stable platform and keep the rear foot on the floor. Lower under control through the available range, then drive through the raised foot to stand.

name: Safety Bar Split Squat
description: A split squat using a safety squat bar for loading.
instructions: Set the yoke securely and hold the handles. Establish a stable split stance, lower with a braced torso, and stand through the front leg without twisting under the bar.

name: Landmine Split Squat
description: A split squat holding an anchored bar end near the chest.
instructions: Secure the pivot, hold the sleeve close, and set a split stance. Lower as the bar follows its arc, then extend the front leg while keeping the trunk square.

name: Forward Lunge
description: A stepping lunge that moves forward before returning to the start.
instructions: Step forward far enough to land with control. Bend both knees, absorb the descent through the front leg, and push the floor away to return to the starting stance.

name: Dumbbell Forward Lunge
description: A forward lunge holding dumbbells at the sides.
instructions: Stand tall with the weights clear of the legs. Step forward, lower by bending both knees, and push back to standing without allowing the front foot to roll inward.

name: Reverse Lunge
description: A stepping lunge performed by moving one foot backward.
instructions: Keep the working foot planted and step the other leg back. Lower the rear knee under control, then push through the front leg to return to standing.

name: Dumbbell Reverse Lunge
description: A reverse lunge loaded with dumbbells.
instructions: Hold the weights by the sides and brace. Step back without losing front-foot pressure, lower smoothly, and stand through the front leg while keeping the pelvis level.

name: Barbell Reverse Lunge
description: A reverse lunge with a barbell carried on the upper back.
instructions: Unrack the bar, brace, and step one foot backward. Lower while keeping the front foot stable, then return to standing without rotating or tipping under the bar.

name: Front-Rack Reverse Lunge
description: A reverse lunge with a barbell in the front-rack position.
instructions: Support the bar across the front shoulders with the elbows forward. Step back, lower under control, and stand through the front leg while maintaining the rack position.

name: Walking Lunge
description: A lunge sequence that travels forward with alternating steps.
instructions: Take a controlled forward step and lower into a lunge. Drive through the leading leg to step into the next repetition, keeping the steps wide enough for balance.

name: Deficit Reverse Lunge
description: A reverse lunge performed with the working foot on a raised platform.
instructions: Stand on a low, stable platform and step the other foot back to the floor. Lower only as far as you can control, then drive through the elevated foot to return.

name: Lateral Lunge
description: A side-stepping lunge that loads one hip and leg in the frontal plane.
instructions: Step sideways and bend the stepping leg while the other stays longer. Sit into the working hip, keep the foot grounded, and push back toward the starting position.

name: Cossack Squat
description: A wide-stance lateral squat alternating between legs.
instructions: Take a wide stance and shift toward one side while bending that knee. Keep the working heel supported, use a comfortable position for the other foot, and move back through center.

name: Step-Up
description: A single-leg step onto a stable elevated platform.
instructions: Place the whole working foot on the step. Lean only as needed for balance, push through that foot to rise, and lower under control without jumping off the trailing leg.

name: Lateral Step-Up
description: A step-up performed with the platform beside the body.
instructions: Stand beside a stable step and place the near foot on it. Drive upward through that leg, keep the pelvis level, and return slowly to the floor.

name: Step-Down
description: A controlled single-leg lowering movement from an elevated surface.
instructions: Stand on a low step and slowly bend the stance knee until the free heel touches the floor. Keep the pelvis steady and rise through the working leg.

name: Pistol Squat
description: A single-leg squat with the free leg extended in front.
instructions: Reach the free leg forward and use the arms for counterbalance. Lower on the working leg through a controlled range, keep the heel supported, and stand without collapsing into the bottom.

name: Assisted Pistol Squat
description: A pistol squat using a stable hand support to reduce balance and strength demands.
instructions: Hold a rail or suspension handles and extend the free leg forward. Lower on the working leg while using only the needed assistance, then stand with controlled support.

name: Skater Squat
description: A single-leg squat with the free leg reaching behind the body.
instructions: Balance on one leg and reach the other knee behind you. Bend the stance leg until the rear knee approaches a pad, then stand while maintaining pelvis and knee control.

name: Conventional Deadlift
description: A barbell lift from the floor using coordinated hip and knee extension.
instructions: Stand with the bar over the midfoot, grip outside the legs, and brace before lifting. Push through the floor, keep the bar close, and finish tall without leaning back. Lower with control.

name: Sumo Deadlift
description: A wide-stance deadlift with the arms positioned inside the legs.
instructions: Take a wide stance with the knees following the toes and grip inside the legs. Brace, remove slack from the bar, and extend the hips and knees together while keeping the bar close.

name: Trap Bar Deadlift
description: A deadlift performed while standing inside a trap bar.
instructions: Center yourself between the handles, brace, and take tension before lifting. Push through both feet to stand with the load balanced at the sides, then lower without tipping the bar.

name: Romanian Deadlift
description: A hip hinge starting from standing, with the knees kept softly bent.
instructions: Hold the bar close to the thighs and brace. Send the hips backward with only a small change in knee angle, lower to a controlled hamstring stretch, and extend the hips to stand.

name: Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift
description: A Romanian deadlift holding a dumbbell in each hand.
instructions: Start tall with the weights near the thighs. Hinge backward at the hips while keeping the weights close, stop before trunk position changes, and stand by extending the hips.

name: Kettlebell Deadlift
description: A floor-to-standing hinge with a kettlebell between the feet.
instructions: Set the bell between the feet, hinge and bend the knees to reach it, then brace. Stand with the arms long and the weight close, and return the bell to the floor under control.

name: Stiff-Leg Deadlift
description: A deadlift variation with less knee bend than a conventional pull.
instructions: Use a light enough load to keep the trunk controlled. Keep the knees slightly unlocked, hinge to the range your hamstrings allow, and extend the hips without forcing the bar to the floor.

name: Single-Leg Romanian Deadlift
description: A single-leg hinge with the free leg moving behind the body.
instructions: Balance on one leg with a soft knee and hinge while reaching the other leg back. Keep the pelvis approximately square, lower through a controlled range, and return by extending the stance hip.

name: Kickstand Romanian Deadlift
description: A staggered-stance hinge with the rear foot providing light support.
instructions: Place most of your weight on the front leg and rest the rear toes slightly behind. Hinge through the front hip, keep the load close, and stand without shifting the work to the rear leg.

name: Sumo Romanian Deadlift
description: A wide-stance Romanian deadlift emphasizing a controlled hip hinge.
instructions: Set a wider stance with the knees aligned to the toes. Start from standing, push the hips back while keeping the bar close, and return upright through hip extension.

name: Snatch-Grip Deadlift
description: A deadlift using a wide snatch-style grip.
instructions: Take a secure wide grip and set the trunk before lifting. Push through the floor with the bar close, maintain balance as it passes the knees, and stand without shrugging it upward.

name: Snatch-Grip Romanian Deadlift
description: A Romanian deadlift using a wide barbell grip.
instructions: Stand with the bar at the thighs in a wide grip. Hinge while keeping the bar close and the upper back engaged, then extend the hips to return without changing the trunk shape.

name: Deficit Deadlift
description: A deadlift performed from a small platform to increase the starting range.
instructions: Use a stable, low platform and a load that permits a sound setup. Brace before the pull, keep the bar close, and extend hips and knees without losing position off the floor.

name: Paused Deadlift
description: A deadlift with a prescribed pause during the ascent.
instructions: Begin as for a controlled deadlift and pause at the assigned height. Keep tension and balance without resting the bar on the legs, then finish the lift and lower smoothly.

name: Block Pull
description: A deadlift beginning with the plates raised on stable blocks.
instructions: Position the plates evenly on blocks at the prescribed height. Brace, take slack out of the bar, stand with it close to the body, and lower both sides back onto the blocks.

name: Rack Pull
description: A deadlift starting with the bar supported on rack pins.
instructions: Set both pins evenly, approach the bar, and establish a braced pulling position. Lift to standing without jerking or leaning back, then return the bar gently to both pins.

name: Good Morning
description: A hip hinge with a barbell carried on the upper back.
instructions: Set rack safeties, secure the bar, and brace with softly bent knees. Move the hips back as the torso inclines, stop within a controlled range, and extend the hips to return upright.

name: Safety Bar Good Morning
description: A good morning performed with a padded safety squat bar.
instructions: Secure the yoke and hold the handles without pulling on them. Brace, hinge backward through the hips, and return upright before trunk control or balance is lost.

name: Seated Good Morning
description: A seated forward hinge with the feet and pelvis supported.
instructions: Sit securely with a comfortable wide stance and a light load. Incline the torso from the hips while keeping control of the spine, then return upright without bouncing off the thighs.

name: Cable Pull-Through
description: A standing hip hinge with a low cable passing between the legs.
instructions: Face away from the low pulley, hold the rope between the legs, and step forward for tension. Hinge back, then extend the hips while keeping the arms passive and the back controlled.

name: Banded Good Morning
description: A hip hinge resisted by a band secured under the feet and across the upper back.
instructions: Stand securely on the band and position it on the upper back, away from the neck. Brace, push the hips backward, and return to standing against the band without snapping upward.

name: Hip Hinge with Dowel
description: An unloaded hinge drill using a dowel for positional feedback.
instructions: Hold a dowel along the back with contact at the head, upper back, and pelvis. Soften the knees and push the hips back while keeping those contacts, then return upright.

name: Barbell Hip Thrust
description: A loaded hip extension with the upper back supported on a bench.
instructions: Secure the bench and pad the bar across the hips. Drive through the feet to bring the torso and thighs into line, keep the ribs controlled, and lower without overextending the lower back.

name: Dumbbell Hip Thrust
description: A hip thrust using a dumbbell across the hips.
instructions: Rest the upper back on a stable bench and secure the dumbbell over the pelvis. Extend the hips until the trunk and thighs align, then lower under control without arching the lower back.

name: Single-Leg Hip Thrust
description: A bench-supported hip thrust performed through one working leg.
instructions: Set the upper back on a stable bench and lift the free foot. Drive through the stance foot while keeping the pelvis level, then lower slowly without twisting.

name: Glute Bridge
description: A floor-based hip extension with the feet planted and shoulders supported.
instructions: Lie on your back with the knees bent and feet grounded. Lift the pelvis by extending the hips, keep the ribs from flaring, and lower the pelvis smoothly.

name: Barbell Glute Bridge
description: A glute bridge loaded with a padded barbell across the hips.
instructions: Lie on the floor, secure a padded bar over the pelvis, and plant the feet. Extend the hips without arching the back, then lower the load under control.

name: Single-Leg Glute Bridge
description: A floor bridge performed with one foot supporting the movement.
instructions: Lie with one foot planted and the other leg lifted. Raise the pelvis through the supporting hip, keep both sides level, and lower without pushing through the neck.

name: B-Stance Hip Thrust
description: A hip thrust with one foot doing most of the work and the other acting as a kickstand.
instructions: Place the working foot near the hips and the supporting heel slightly farther forward. Extend the hips while keeping the pelvis level and most pressure on the working side.

name: Frog Pump
description: A short-range hip extension with the soles of the feet together and knees opened outward.
instructions: Lie on your back, bring the soles together, and let the knees open comfortably. Lift the hips using the glutes without forcing the knees down or arching the lower back.

name: Cable Glute Kickback
description: A cable-resisted hip extension performed one leg at a time.
instructions: Attach the ankle cuff and use a stable handhold. Move the working thigh backward while keeping the pelvis facing forward, then return without swinging or extending the lower back.

name: Quadruped Hip Extension
description: A hands-and-knees hip extension with a bent working knee.
instructions: Start on hands and knees and brace gently. Lift one bent leg behind you by extending the hip, stop before the lower back arches, and return without rotating the pelvis.

name: Back Extension
description: A bench-supported hinge that extends the hips while the torso stays controlled.
instructions: Set the pad below the hip crease so the hips can bend. Lower the torso through a controlled hinge and rise until the body is straight, avoiding an exaggerated backward arch.

name: Reverse Hyperextension
description: A supported hip extension with the torso resting on a reverse-hyper platform.
instructions: Support the torso and hold the handles securely. Lift the legs through hip extension only as far as trunk control allows, then lower without throwing the legs or forcing lumbar extension.

name: Nordic Hamstring Curl
description: A kneeling knee-flexor exercise that controls the body as it leans forward.
instructions: Pad the knees and secure the ankles with suitable equipment or a partner. Keep the hips extended, lower forward slowly, and use the hands to catch and assist the return when needed.

name: Assisted Nordic Hamstring Curl
description: A Nordic curl performed with controlled external assistance.
instructions: Secure the ankles and use a firmly anchored assistance band or support. Lower from the knees with the hips extended, use the assistance to maintain control, and return without folding at the hips.

name: Glute-Ham Raise
description: A knee-flexion and hip-control exercise performed on a glute-ham developer.
instructions: Adjust the footplate and knee pad so the knees can move safely. Lower the body under control, then bend the knees to rise while keeping the hips and trunk coordinated.

name: Sliding Leg Curl
description: A supine leg curl with the heels sliding along the floor.
instructions: Place the heels on sliders and lift into a bridge. Extend the knees without letting the hips collapse, then pull the heels back toward the body under control.

name: Stability Ball Leg Curl
description: A leg curl performed with the heels on a stability ball.
instructions: Lie on your back with the heels on the ball and raise the hips. Bend the knees to roll the ball inward, then extend them again while keeping the pelvis steady.

name: Hamstring Walkout
description: A bridge variation that lengthens the legs through small heel steps.
instructions: Lift into a bridge, then take short alternating heel steps away from the hips. Stop before pelvic control is lost and walk the heels back while maintaining hip height.

name: Standing Cable Leg Curl
description: A unilateral knee curl using a low cable and ankle cuff.
instructions: Secure the cuff and hold a stable support. Keep the thigh still as you bend the knee against the cable, then straighten under control without swinging the hip.

name: Prone Banded Leg Curl
description: A prone knee curl resisted by a band anchored beyond the feet.
instructions: Anchor the band securely and lie facing down with it attached at the ankle. Bend the knee while keeping the thigh supported, then straighten slowly without lifting the pelvis.

name: Barbell Bench Press
description: A flat-bench press with a barbell, training horizontal pressing strength.
instructions: Set the rack safeties or arrange a spotter, plant the feet, and establish a stable upper back. Lower the bar toward the chest with stacked wrists, then press upward without bouncing.

name: Paused Bench Press
description: A bench press with a motionless pause on the chest.
instructions: Lower the bar under control to the chest and pause without sinking or relaxing the upper back. Press on the prescribed cue while maintaining a stable foot and shoulder position.

name: Spoto Press
description: A bench press paused just above the chest rather than resting on it.
instructions: Set up as for a bench press and lower the bar to a small, consistent gap above the chest. Hold the suspended position without touching or sinking, then press while maintaining tension.

name: Close-Grip Bench Press
description: A bench press using a narrower grip to increase the elbow-extension demand.
instructions: Choose a grip that keeps the wrists comfortable and the forearms controlled. Lower toward the lower chest with the elbows tracking naturally, then press without allowing the wrists to fold back.

name: Wide-Grip Bench Press
description: A bench press using a wider hand position than the lifter's standard grip.
instructions: Use rack safeties and a grip within a comfortable shoulder range. Lower the bar under control with the forearms supported beneath it, then press without bouncing or forcing excessive shoulder depth.

name: Incline Barbell Bench Press
description: A barbell press on an inclined bench that changes the pressing angle.
instructions: Set the bench and rack so the bar can be unracked safely. Lower toward the upper chest with the wrists stacked, then press without sliding down the bench or excessively arching the lower back.

name: Decline Barbell Bench Press
description: A barbell press on a decline bench with the legs secured.
instructions: Secure the legs and use an appropriate rack or spotter. Lower the bar toward the lower chest in a controlled path, then press without losing contact with the bench.

name: Larsen Press
description: A bench press performed with the legs extended and feet unsupported.
instructions: Use a stable upper-back position and appropriate safeties. Hold the legs clear of the floor, lower the bar to the chest, and press without introducing leg drive or rocking the torso.

name: Feet-Up Bench Press
description: A bench press performed with the feet supported on the bench instead of the floor.
instructions: Place the feet securely on the bench and select a load that allows balance without leg drive. Keep the shoulders supported, lower under control, and press without shifting the body sideways.

name: Pin Bench Press
description: A bench press that lowers to rack pins and restarts from a dead stop.
instructions: Set both safeties to the prescribed bar height and position the bench evenly. Lower the bar onto the pins, pause without bouncing, and press while keeping the wrists under the bar.

name: Board Press
description: A bench press with a stable board or purpose-built block limiting the lowering range.
instructions: Secure the board using an appropriate holder or spotter and set safeties. Lower gently to the board without collapsing into it, then press through the prescribed partial range.

name: Barbell Floor Press
description: A barbell press performed on the floor, limiting shoulder extension at the bottom.
instructions: Use a safe rack setup and lie with the upper back supported on the floor. Lower until the upper arms contact the floor gently, pause without relaxing, and press upward.

name: Dumbbell Bench Press
description: A flat-bench press using independently held dumbbells.
instructions: Bring the dumbbells into position with control and set the shoulders against the bench. Lower beside the chest through a comfortable range, then press up without crashing the weights together.

name: Incline Dumbbell Bench Press
description: A dumbbell press performed on an inclined bench.
instructions: Sit back with the weights controlled and the head supported. Lower the dumbbells beside the upper chest, then press upward along a comfortable path without lifting the ribs excessively.

name: Decline Dumbbell Bench Press
description: A dumbbell press performed on a decline bench.
instructions: Secure the legs and obtain assistance positioning heavy dumbbells when needed. Lower the weights beside the lower chest, then press without losing balance on the bench.

name: Neutral-Grip Dumbbell Bench Press
description: A dumbbell bench press performed with the palms facing each other.
instructions: Keep a neutral grip and lower the dumbbells with the elbows tracking close enough for comfort. Press upward while maintaining stacked wrists and a stable upper back.

name: Dumbbell Floor Press
description: A dumbbell press from the floor with a controlled bottom stop.
instructions: Lie with the dumbbells above the chest. Lower until the upper arms lightly meet the floor, keep the wrists vertical, and press without bouncing the elbows.

name: Single-Arm Dumbbell Bench Press
description: A bench press with one dumbbell that adds an anti-rotation demand.
instructions: Position one dumbbell safely and keep both feet planted. Lower and press without letting the torso roll off the bench, using the free arm for balance rather than pushing the weight.

name: Alternating Dumbbell Bench Press
description: A dumbbell bench press in which one arm moves while the other holds its position.
instructions: Set both dumbbells above the chest. Lower and press one side at a time while keeping the other arm stable and preventing the torso from rocking.

name: Dumbbell Squeeze Press
description: A dumbbell press performed while maintaining inward pressure between the weights.
instructions: Hold the dumbbells together above the chest with a neutral grip. Maintain gentle inward pressure as you lower and press, without letting the weights separate or the wrists bend back.

name: Swiss Bar Bench Press
description: A bench press using a multi-grip bar with neutral or angled handles.
instructions: Select matched handles that suit the shoulders and wrists, then set safeties. Lower the bar under control to the prescribed depth and press while keeping both ends level.

name: Push-Up
description: A bodyweight horizontal press from a straight-arm plank.
instructions: Place the hands in a comfortable position and brace from shoulders to heels. Bend the elbows to lower the chest, then push the floor away while allowing the shoulder blades to move naturally.

name: Incline Push-Up
description: A push-up with the hands on an elevated, stable support.
instructions: Place the hands on a bench or bar secured against movement. Keep the body aligned, lower the chest toward the support, and press back without sagging through the waist.

name: Kneeling Push-Up
description: A push-up performed with the knees supported on the floor.
instructions: Form a straight line from the shoulders to the knees. Lower the chest by bending the elbows, then press upward without leaving the hips behind.

name: Decline Push-Up
description: A push-up with the feet elevated on a stable surface.
instructions: Place the feet on a low platform and the hands on the floor. Lower the chest with a braced trunk, then press up without letting the lower back sag.

name: Close-Grip Push-Up
description: A push-up using a narrower hand position to emphasize elbow extension.
instructions: Bring the hands closer together while keeping the wrists comfortable. Lower with the elbows tracking naturally, then press without losing trunk alignment.

name: Deficit Push-Up
description: A push-up using handles or supports that allow the chest to lower below the hands.
instructions: Place stable handles or blocks under the hands. Lower only through a shoulder range you can control, then press back while keeping the supports from tipping.

name: Ring Push-Up
description: A push-up performed with the hands supported in freely moving rings.
instructions: Set the rings to equal height and brace the body. Lower with the rings controlled beside the chest, then press without allowing them to swing far outward.

name: Weighted Push-Up
description: A push-up with added load secured to the torso.
instructions: Use a weighted vest or securely positioned resistance rather than a loose load. Maintain body alignment as you lower and press, and stop before the added weight compromises control.

name: Banded Push-Up
description: A push-up against a resistance band running across the upper back.
instructions: Secure the band under the palms and across the upper back away from the neck. Lower smoothly, then press against the increasing tension without letting the band slip.

name: Archer Push-Up
description: A push-up that shifts most of the load toward one arm while the other provides assistance.
instructions: Start with a wide, stable hand position. Shift toward one arm as its elbow bends and the other arm stays longer, then press back through center with the torso controlled.

name: Parallel Bar Dip
description: A bodyweight press performed between parallel bars.
instructions: Support yourself with straight arms, then lower by bending the elbows through a comfortable shoulder range. Press back up without bouncing at the bottom or swinging the legs.

name: Weighted Dip
description: A parallel bar dip with additional load secured to the body.
instructions: Secure the added weight so it cannot swing into the legs. Lower between the bars under control and press back up while keeping the load stable.

name: Ring Dip
description: A dip performed on suspended rings that must be stabilized throughout the movement.
instructions: Establish a steady support position before descending. Keep the rings close enough for control, lower within your available shoulder range, and press without letting the rings flare unpredictably.

name: Dumbbell Fly
description: A chest fly using dumbbells with the elbows kept slightly bent.
instructions: Lie on a flat bench with the dumbbells above the chest. Open the arms through a controlled shoulder range, then bring the weights together without turning the movement into a deep press.

name: Incline Dumbbell Fly
description: A dumbbell fly performed on an inclined bench.
instructions: Support the head and back on the incline and maintain a soft elbow bend. Open the arms until the shoulders reach a comfortable range, then sweep the weights back above the upper chest.

name: Cable Fly
description: A standing fly using two cable handles at approximately chest height.
instructions: Set a stable stance with the handles at the sides. Keep a consistent elbow bend as you bring the arms together in front of the chest, then return without letting the cables pull you backward.

name: Low-to-High Cable Fly
description: A cable fly that follows an upward and inward path from low pulleys.
instructions: Stand between low pulleys and begin with the hands beside the hips. Sweep the arms upward and inward with softly bent elbows, then return without lifting the ribs or swinging.

name: High-to-Low Cable Fly
description: A cable fly following a downward and inward path from high pulleys.
instructions: Set the pulleys above shoulder height and take a stable stance. Bring the handles down and together in front of the torso, then open the arms under control.

name: Standing Cable Chest Press
description: A standing horizontal press using cable handles.
instructions: Face away from the pulleys with the handles near the chest and a stable split stance. Press forward while resisting trunk rotation, then return the handles without losing balance.

name: Single-Arm Cable Chest Press
description: A one-arm cable press that requires the trunk to resist rotation.
instructions: Set the handle behind you near chest height and brace in a stable stance. Press forward without turning the torso, then return slowly with the shoulder controlled.

name: Barbell Overhead Press
description: A strict standing press from the front shoulders to overhead.
instructions: Start with the bar at shoulder height, brace the trunk, and keep the legs still. Press past the face and finish with the bar balanced overhead, then lower without leaning excessively backward.

name: Seated Barbell Shoulder Press
description: A barbell overhead press performed from a seated position.
instructions: Use a stable bench and safe unrack position. Press from the prescribed shoulder height to overhead while keeping the pelvis supported, then lower without forcing the elbows behind the body.

name: Dumbbell Shoulder Press
description: A seated overhead press with independently held dumbbells.
instructions: Sit with the feet supported and bring the dumbbells beside the shoulders. Press along a comfortable overhead path, allow the shoulder blades to rotate upward, and lower under control.

name: Standing Dumbbell Shoulder Press
description: A strict overhead press using two dumbbells while standing.
instructions: Brace the abdomen and hold the dumbbells at shoulder level. Press without using a leg dip or excessive back extension, then lower both weights smoothly.

name: Single-Arm Dumbbell Overhead Press
description: A strict one-arm overhead press with an anti-lateral-flexion demand.
instructions: Hold one dumbbell at the shoulder and stand evenly. Press overhead without bending sideways, then lower while keeping the ribs and pelvis controlled.

name: Arnold Press
description: A dumbbell shoulder press with controlled rotation during the press.
instructions: Begin with the dumbbells in front of the shoulders and the palms facing you. Rotate toward a comfortable pressing grip while lifting overhead, then reverse the path without forcing the shoulders.

name: Z Press
description: An overhead press performed seated on the floor with the legs extended.
instructions: Sit upright with the legs extended and use a manageable load. Press the bar overhead without collapsing the torso or leaning far backward, then lower to the front rack.

name: Overhead Pin Press
description: An overhead press beginning from a bar supported on rack pins.
instructions: Set both pins at the prescribed starting height, such as chin or forehead level. Brace beneath the bar, press from a complete stop, and return it evenly to the pins without bouncing.

name: Bradford Press
description: An alternating front-to-back press that moves the bar just over the head.
instructions: Use a very light bar and only a comfortable shoulder range. Lift it over the crown toward a controlled behind-head position, then reverse without pushing the neck forward or forcing depth.

name: Landmine Press
description: An angled press using the end of an anchored barbell.
instructions: Secure the pivot and hold the sleeve near one shoulder. Press forward and upward along its arc while allowing the shoulder blade to move, then return without rotating the trunk.

name: Half-Kneeling Landmine Press
description: A landmine press performed with one knee on the floor.
instructions: Set a stable half-kneeling stance and hold the bar near the shoulder. Press along the arc without flaring the ribs or turning the pelvis, then lower smoothly.

name: Two-Handed Landmine Press
description: An angled press holding a landmine sleeve with both hands.
instructions: Hold the anchored bar end close to the upper chest. Press forward and upward without leaning into the lower back, then return to the chest with the elbows controlled.

name: Kettlebell Strict Press
description: A strict one-arm overhead press from the kettlebell rack position.
instructions: Rack the bell close to the forearm and upper arm. Brace and press overhead without a leg dip, keeping the wrist controlled, then return to the rack smoothly.

name: Kettlebell Bottoms-Up Press
description: An overhead press holding a kettlebell inverted above the handle.
instructions: Use a light bell and establish a stable bottoms-up rack. Press slowly without letting the bell tip, then lower with control and stop if the grip cannot keep it balanced.

name: Pike Push-Up
description: A bodyweight overhead-pressing pattern with the hips raised.
instructions: Set the hands on the floor and raise the hips. Bend the elbows to lower the head toward a point ahead of the hands, then press away while keeping the neck unloaded.

name: Handstand Push-Up
description: An advanced inverted press performed from a handstand position.
instructions: Use an appropriate stable support and a range you can control. Lower slowly through the arms without dropping weight onto the head, then press back to the handstand.

name: Leg Press
description: A machine-based leg press covering horizontal, angled, and plate-loaded designs.
instructions: Adjust the seat and stops for the machine in use. Keep the pelvis supported as the hips and knees bend, then press through the feet without forcing the knees into hyperextension.

name: Hack Squat
description: A supported machine squat with the torso against a moving back pad.
instructions: Position the shoulders and back against the pads and set the safety stops. Descend while keeping the feet supported, then extend the legs without lifting the pelvis off the pad.

name: Pendulum Squat
description: A supported squat machine that moves through a pivoting arc.
instructions: Adjust the pads and safety system, then choose a stance compatible with the platform. Follow the machine's arc to a controlled depth and stand without bouncing at the bottom.

name: Belt Squat
description: A squat loaded through a belt around the hips rather than the upper back.
instructions: Secure the belt and check the attachment and platform clearance. Squat while keeping the load centered beneath the hips, then stand and re-engage the safety mechanism before removing the belt.

name: Leg Extension
description: A machine knee-extension exercise for the quadriceps.
instructions: Align the knees with the machine pivot and place the shin pad above the ankles. Extend the knees through the prescribed range, then lower without letting the weight stack slam.

name: Leg Curl
description: A machine knee-flexion exercise covering seated, lying, or standing designs.
instructions: Adjust the machine to align the working knee with its pivot and position the resistance pad above the heel. Keep the pelvis controlled and use the provided supports while bending and straightening the knee. Specify the machine position in program notes.

name: Hip Abduction Machine
description: A machine exercise that moves the thighs apart against resistance.
instructions: Adjust the seat and pads so the thighs are supported. Open the legs through a controlled range without jerking or rocking the torso, then return against the resistance.

name: Hip Adduction Machine
description: A machine exercise that brings the thighs together against resistance.
instructions: Choose a comfortable starting width and align the pads with the inner thighs. Bring the legs together smoothly, then reopen without allowing the machine to force a painful stretch.

name: Hip Thrust Machine
description: A supported machine hip thrust using a belt or padded lever over the hips.
instructions: Secure the restraint over the pelvis and set the feet. Extend the hips until the trunk and thighs align, then lower with the ribs controlled rather than arching the lower back.

name: Glute Kickback Machine
description: A machine hip-extension exercise pressing the thigh or foot backward.
instructions: Adjust the torso support and working-leg pad or platform. Drive the leg backward from the hip without rotating the pelvis or arching the back, then return slowly.

name: Standing Calf Raise Machine
description: A loaded calf raise performed with the knees relatively straight.
instructions: Set the shoulder pads and place the forefeet securely on the platform. Lower the heels through a controllable range, then rise onto the balls of the feet without bouncing.

name: Seated Calf Raise Machine
description: A calf raise performed with bent knees and resistance over the thighs.
instructions: Position the thigh pad securely and support the forefeet on the platform. Raise and lower the heels while keeping the knees bent and the load controlled.

name: Chest Press
description: A machine chest press covering different brands, loading systems, and pressing angles.
instructions: Set the seat and handles for a comfortable starting position. Keep the torso supported, press along the machine's path, and return without letting the shoulders roll abruptly forward. Specify angle or grip in program notes.

name: Shoulder Press Machine
description: A machine-guided overhead press.
instructions: Adjust the seat so the handles start at a manageable shoulder height. Press upward without forcing the lower back into an arch, then lower through a controlled range.

name: Pec Deck
description: A machine chest fly using hand grips or forearm pads.
instructions: Adjust the seat and starting angle so the shoulders are comfortable. Bring the arms together in front of the chest with the prescribed elbow position, then open under control.

name: Reverse Pec Deck
description: A machine reverse fly for the rear shoulders and scapular retractors.
instructions: Face the pad and adjust the handles near shoulder height. Open the arms out and back with a soft elbow bend, then return without jerking the torso off the support.

name: Lat Pulldown
description: A machine or cable pulldown bringing an overhead handle toward the upper chest.
instructions: Secure the thigh pad and grip the selected attachment. Pull the elbows downward as the handle approaches the upper chest, then return overhead with control; do not pull behind the neck.

name: Machine Row
description: A machine-guided row covering supported and plate-loaded rowing designs.
instructions: Adjust the seat and chest support to match the handle path. Pull the elbows backward without heaving the torso, then reach forward under control. Specify handle and seat preferences in program notes.

name: Pullover Machine
description: A machine shoulder-extension movement performed with the elbows on pads or hands on a lever.
instructions: Align the seat and arm support with the machine instructions. Pull the lever toward the torso without turning it into a trunk crunch, then return overhead only as far as the shoulders allow.

name: Biceps Curl Machine
description: An elbow-flexion exercise with the upper arms supported by a machine pad.
instructions: Align the elbows with the pivot and hold the handles with comfortable wrists. Curl without lifting the upper arms off the pad, then lower without dropping the load.

name: Triceps Extension Machine
description: A machine exercise that extends the elbows from a supported position.
instructions: Adjust the seat and arm support so the elbows align with the intended pivot. Straighten the elbows without driving the movement through the shoulders, then bend them under control.

name: Triceps Dip Machine
description: A seated machine press-down that combines elbow extension with a dipping arm path.
instructions: Set the seat and grips, keeping the torso supported. Press the handles down by extending the elbows, then return without shrugging or allowing the shoulders to move beyond a comfortable range.

name: Lateral Raise Machine
description: A machine shoulder-abduction exercise using elbow pads or hand grips.
instructions: Adjust the seat so the pads contact the upper arms as intended. Raise the arms outward through a comfortable arc without leaning or jerking, then lower slowly.

name: Assisted Pull-Up Machine
description: A pull-up with machine assistance reducing the effective bodyweight load.
instructions: Select assistance, use the steps, and place the knees or feet on the support as designed. Pull upward without swinging, then lower under control before carefully leaving the moving platform.

name: Assisted Dip Machine
description: A parallel-bar dip using a counterweighted support.
instructions: Select assistance and position the body according to the machine instructions. Lower by bending the elbows through a comfortable range, then press up while keeping the support stable.

name: Abdominal Crunch Machine
description: A machine-loaded trunk-flexion exercise.
instructions: Adjust the pads so the resistance follows the trunk rather than pulling on the neck. Bring the ribs toward the pelvis through a controlled curl, then return without slamming the stack.

name: Back Extension Machine
description: A machine exercise extending the trunk against a supported lever.
instructions: Align the pelvis and back pad according to the machine instructions. Extend from a controlled forward position toward upright without forceful hyperextension, then return smoothly.

name: Torso Rotation Machine
description: A seated machine exercise rotating the trunk through a limited, controlled range.
instructions: Adjust the supports and starting angle before loading. Rotate the torso without jerking or forcing the end range, then return while keeping the pelvis positioned as intended by the machine.

name: Smith Machine Squat
description: A squat performed with a bar constrained to the Smith machine rails.
instructions: Set safety stops and choose a foot position compatible with the bar path. Squat with the feet supported and trunk controlled, then stand and re-hook the bar deliberately.

name: Smith Machine Split Squat
description: A split squat using the guided Smith machine bar.
instructions: Set the stops and establish a balanced split stance. Bend both knees with most pressure through the front foot, then stand without letting the rails force an uncomfortable position.

name: Smith Machine Romanian Deadlift
description: A Romanian deadlift using a guided bar path.
instructions: Position the feet so the bar can stay close to the legs and release the hooks. Move the hips backward with softly bent knees, then extend the hips without leaning backward at the top.

name: Smith Machine Hip Thrust
description: A hip thrust loaded by a padded Smith machine bar.
instructions: Place a stable bench behind the shoulders and pad the bar across the hips. Set suitable safeties, drive the hips upward with controlled ribs, and lower without letting the bench move.

name: Smith Machine Bench Press
description: A bench press performed under a guided Smith machine bar.
instructions: Position the bench so the fixed path matches a comfortable chest press and set safeties. Lower the bar with stable wrists and shoulders, then press and re-hook it with control.

name: Smith Machine Shoulder Press
description: A seated overhead press using the Smith machine rails.
instructions: Position a stable bench so the bar clears the face without forcing the shoulders back. Set safeties, press overhead with the trunk supported, and lower through the selected range.

name: Smith Machine Calf Raise
description: A standing calf raise loaded with a Smith machine bar.
instructions: Set the safeties and use a secure foot platform if needed. Support the bar on the upper back, rise through the forefeet, and lower the heels without bouncing.

name: Barbell Bent-Over Row
description: A row performed while holding a hip-hinged standing position.
instructions: Hinge at the hips with the bar hanging below the shoulders. Pull toward the torso without repeatedly raising the trunk, then lower until the arms reach forward under control.

name: Pendlay Row
description: A bent-over barbell row starting each repetition from the floor.
instructions: Hinge into a stable position with the bar resting beneath the shoulders. Brace, row toward the lower chest or upper abdomen, and return to a full stop without bouncing or standing up.

name: Underhand Barbell Row
description: A bent-over row with a supinated grip.
instructions: Grip the bar with the palms forward and hinge to a stable torso angle. Row toward the abdomen with comfortable wrists, then lower without swinging or forcing the elbows behind the body.

name: Dumbbell Bent-Over Row
description: A bilateral row using dumbbells from a hinged stance.
instructions: Hinge at the hips and let the dumbbells hang beneath the shoulders. Pull the elbows back without shrugging or changing torso angle, then lower both weights smoothly.

name: Single-Arm Dumbbell Row
description: A one-arm dumbbell row with the free hand supported.
instructions: Brace the free hand on a stable bench or rack and keep the pelvis steady. Row the dumbbell toward the hip or lower ribs, then lower without rotating to throw the weight.

name: Chest-Supported Dumbbell Row
description: A dumbbell row with the chest resting on an inclined bench.
instructions: Lie against an incline bench with the feet stable. Pull the elbows back through the chosen path, then lower with the chest remaining on the pad.

name: Seal Row
description: A barbell row performed prone on an elevated horizontal bench.
instructions: Use a bench high enough for the bar to clear the floor. Keep the chest supported as you pull the bar toward the underside of the bench, then lower without lifting the torso.

name: T-Bar Row
description: A close-grip row using a landmine bar and a secure row handle.
instructions: Stand over the anchored bar and hinge with a stable back. Pull the handle toward the torso without heaving upward, then lower while maintaining the hip hinge.

name: Meadows Row
description: A one-arm landmine row performed from a staggered stance beside the bar end.
instructions: Secure the landmine and hold the sleeve with an overhand grip. Brace in a staggered hinge, row the elbow outward and back, and lower without twisting sharply through the trunk.

name: Seated Cable Row
description: A seated row using a low cable and a stable foot support.
instructions: Sit tall with softly bent knees and reach for the handle. Row toward the torso without rocking backward, then allow a controlled forward reach as the cable returns.

name: Single-Arm Cable Row
description: A cable row performed with one arm.
instructions: Choose a stance or seated support that keeps the trunk steady. Pull the handle toward the lower ribs without rotating excessively, then return with a controlled shoulder-blade reach.

name: High Cable Row
description: A row pulling from an elevated cable toward the upper torso.
instructions: Set the cable above shoulder height and brace in a stable stance. Pull the elbows backward and downward toward the upper ribs, then return without lifting the shoulders toward the ears.

name: Wide-Grip Cable Row
description: A cable row with the elbows traveling farther outward.
instructions: Take a wide handle and sit with a stable trunk. Row toward the upper abdomen with the elbows out to a comfortable angle, then reach forward without losing control of the weight.

name: Inverted Row
description: A bodyweight row with the body suspended beneath a fixed bar.
instructions: Set the bar securely and keep the body aligned from head to heels. Pull the chest toward the bar, then lower without dropping the hips or reaching the chin forward.

name: Ring Row
description: A bodyweight row using suspended rings.
instructions: Lean back with the feet secure and the rings held evenly. Pull the chest toward the hands while keeping the body aligned, then lower as the shoulders reach forward under control.

name: Renegade Row
description: An alternating dumbbell row from a plank position.
instructions: Use stable dumbbells and a wide enough foot stance. Row one weight while resisting trunk rotation, place it down securely, and repeat on the other side without shifting the hips excessively.

name: Gorilla Row
description: An alternating kettlebell row from a wide hip-hinged stance.
instructions: Place two bells between the feet and hinge over them. Row one bell while stabilizing the trunk and the other side, then return it to the floor before alternating.

name: Pull-Up
description: A bodyweight vertical pull using a pronated grip.
instructions: Hang from a secure bar with an engaged shoulder position. Pull until the chin clears the bar through a controlled path, then lower without swinging or dropping abruptly into the hang.

name: Chin-Up
description: A bodyweight vertical pull with the palms facing toward the lifter.
instructions: Grip a secure bar with comfortable wrists and elbows. Pull upward without kicking, then lower through a controlled range while keeping the shoulders supported.

name: Neutral-Grip Pull-Up
description: A pull-up performed on parallel handles with the palms facing each other.
instructions: Hang from secure parallel handles, brace, and pull the elbows downward. Rise without swinging the legs, then lower with control through the available shoulder range.

name: Weighted Pull-Up
description: A pull-up with additional weight secured to the body.
instructions: Secure the load so it cannot swing and choose a stable grip. Pull upward without kipping, then lower smoothly while maintaining control of the added weight.

name: Weighted Chin-Up
description: A supinated-grip chin-up with added external load.
instructions: Attach the load securely and begin from a controlled hang. Pull the chest upward without leg swing, then return under control while keeping the wrists and elbows comfortable.

name: Band-Assisted Pull-Up
description: A pull-up using an anchored resistance band for assistance.
instructions: Secure the band to the bar and position the foot or knee carefully. Pull without bouncing on the band, lower with control, and use support when getting in or out of the setup.

name: Eccentric Pull-Up
description: A pull-up variation emphasizing a controlled lowering phase.
instructions: Use a step to reach the top position rather than jumping blindly. Lower slowly through a manageable range, then return to the step to reset for the next repetition.

name: Single-Arm Lat Pulldown
description: A one-arm cable pulldown from an overhead attachment.
instructions: Sit or kneel with the trunk stable and the arm reaching overhead. Pull the elbow toward the side of the torso, then return without rotating or bending sideways.

name: Straight-Arm Cable Pulldown
description: A shoulder-extension movement with the elbows kept nearly straight.
instructions: Face a high pulley and hold the attachment with a slight elbow bend. Sweep the arms toward the thighs without turning the movement into a triceps press, then return overhead under control.

name: Dumbbell Pullover
description: A shoulder-extension exercise lowering a dumbbell behind the head while lying on a bench.
instructions: Lie lengthwise with the head and pelvis supported and hold the dumbbell securely. Lower behind the head only through a controllable shoulder range, then return without flaring the ribs.

name: Dumbbell Lateral Raise
description: A shoulder-abduction exercise lifting dumbbells out to the sides.
instructions: Stand with a slight elbow bend and raise the arms slightly forward of the frontal plane if more comfortable. Lift without swinging the torso, then lower smoothly.

name: Seated Dumbbell Lateral Raise
description: A lateral raise performed seated to reduce assistance from the legs.
instructions: Sit with the feet supported and dumbbells at the sides. Raise the arms outward with controlled elbows, then lower without bouncing or shrugging abruptly.

name: Cable Lateral Raise
description: A one-arm lateral raise against a low cable.
instructions: Stand beside a low pulley with the handle in the far hand. Raise the arm outward through a comfortable path, keeping the trunk steady, then lower against the cable tension.

name: Lean-Away Cable Lateral Raise
description: A cable lateral raise performed while leaning away from a stable hand support.
instructions: Hold a fixed support with the free hand and lean away only enough to remain balanced. Raise the working arm without twisting, then lower slowly along the same path.

name: Dumbbell Front Raise
description: A shoulder-flexion exercise lifting dumbbells in front of the body.
instructions: Hold the weights in front of the thighs with comfortable wrists. Raise the arms forward without leaning back, then lower under control to the starting position.

name: Cable Front Raise
description: A forward arm raise using a low cable.
instructions: Stand with a stable trunk and the handle near the front of the thigh. Raise the arm forward through the prescribed range, then return without using momentum.

name: Plate Front Raise
description: A shoulder-flexion exercise holding one weight plate with both hands.
instructions: Grip the plate securely and brace the trunk. Lift it forward without swinging or arching the back, then lower while maintaining a firm two-handed grip.

name: Bent-Over Dumbbell Reverse Fly
description: A rear-shoulder fly performed from a hip-hinged position.
instructions: Hinge with a stable back and hold the weights below the chest. Open the arms outward with softly bent elbows, then lower without lifting the torso to move the weights.

name: Chest-Supported Reverse Fly
description: A rear-shoulder fly with the chest supported on an incline bench.
instructions: Lie against the bench with the head in a neutral position. Sweep the arms outward without jerking or lifting the chest, then return the weights slowly.

name: Cable Reverse Fly
description: A reverse fly using crossed cable handles at roughly shoulder height.
instructions: Stand between the pulleys and hold the opposite-side handles. Open the arms through a controlled arc, then return without rotating the trunk or forcing the elbows behind the shoulders.

name: Band Pull-Apart
description: A horizontal arm-opening movement against an elastic band.
instructions: Hold a light band in front of the chest with the elbows softly extended. Spread the hands while keeping the ribs controlled, then return without snapping the band inward.

name: Face Pull
description: A high cable pull toward the face with the elbows held outward.
instructions: Anchor the cable around upper-chest to eye height and hold a rope securely. Pull toward the face while opening the hands and controlling the shoulder blades, then return without leaning back.

name: Barbell Upright Row
description: A vertical barbell pull in front of the torso combining elbow lift and shoulder abduction.
instructions: Use a comfortable grip and a moderate load. Pull the bar close to the body only to a height the shoulders tolerate, then lower without forcing the elbows high or bending the wrists sharply.

name: Cable Upright Row
description: An upright row using a low cable attachment.
instructions: Stand close enough to keep the cable path controlled. Raise the elbows outward through a comfortable range as the handle travels upward, then lower without body swing.

name: Dumbbell Shrug
description: A shoulder-elevation exercise holding dumbbells at the sides.
instructions: Stand tall with the weights clear of the thighs. Lift the shoulders upward without rolling them in circles or moving the neck, then lower slowly.

name: Barbell Shrug
description: A loaded shoulder shrug with a barbell held in front of the body.
instructions: Hold the bar with a stable grip and softly unlocked knees. Elevate the shoulders without bending the elbows to row the bar, then return under control.

name: Trap Bar Shrug
description: A shrug using neutral handles on a trap bar.
instructions: Lift the trap bar safely and stand centered inside it. Elevate and lower the shoulders without bouncing through the knees or leaning the torso.

name: Kelso Shrug
description: A chest-supported scapular retraction movement with the elbows kept nearly straight.
instructions: Lie on an incline bench holding light dumbbells beneath the shoulders. Draw the shoulder blades together without turning the movement into a full row, then release into a controlled reach.

name: Scapular Pull-Up
description: A hanging shoulder-blade movement performed with the elbows nearly straight.
instructions: Hang from a secure bar within a comfortable shoulder range. Lift the torso slightly by controlling the shoulder blades without bending the elbows, then return slowly without dropping into the joints.

name: Scapular Push-Up
description: A plank-based shoulder-blade movement with the elbows kept straight.
instructions: Hold a stable plank and keep the elbows extended. Let the chest move slightly between the shoulders, then push the floor away to spread the shoulder blades without rounding through the whole trunk.

name: Wall Slide
description: An upward arm slide against a wall emphasizing controlled scapular movement.
instructions: Place the forearms against the wall with the ribs stacked over the pelvis. Slide upward while allowing the shoulder blades to rotate, then lower without forcing the lower back into an arch.

name: Serratus Punch
description: A supine shoulder-blade reach with the arm held toward the ceiling.
instructions: Lie on your back holding a light dumbbell over the shoulder. Keep the elbow straight and reach the hand upward by lifting the shoulder blade slightly, then lower the shoulder blade without bending the arm.

name: Prone Y Raise
description: A prone arm raise with the arms arranged in a Y shape.
instructions: Lie face down on a bench with light or no weights and thumbs pointing upward. Lift the arms diagonally overhead through a small controlled range, then lower without arching the back.

name: Prone T Raise
description: A prone horizontal arm raise with the arms forming a T.
instructions: Support the chest and keep the neck neutral. Raise the arms out to the sides with a comfortable thumb position, then lower without jerking or lifting the torso.

name: Prone W Raise
description: A prone shoulder-blade and external-rotation drill with bent elbows.
instructions: Lie with the chest supported and the elbows bent into a W. Lift the hands and elbows slightly while drawing the shoulder blades together, then lower without forcing the shoulders into end range.

name: Cable Shoulder External Rotation
description: Shoulder external rotation against a cable with the elbow beside the torso.
instructions: Set the cable near elbow height and hold the elbow gently against the side. Rotate the forearm outward without turning the torso or moving the upper arm, then return slowly.

name: Banded Shoulder External Rotation
description: Shoulder external rotation using an elastic band anchored beside the body.
instructions: Anchor the band securely near elbow height and bend the elbow. Keep the upper arm close to the side while rotating the hand outward, then return without snapping the band.

name: Side-Lying Dumbbell External Rotation
description: External rotation performed lying on the opposite side with a light dumbbell.
instructions: Support the head and keep the upper elbow beside the torso, using a towel if helpful. Rotate the forearm upward without rolling backward, then lower within a comfortable range.

name: Cable External Rotation at Shoulder Height
description: External rotation with the upper arm supported or held near shoulder height.
instructions: Use a light cable and a comfortable abducted arm position. Keep the elbow location steady as the forearm rotates backward, then return without forcing the shoulder or extending the lower back.

name: Prone External Rotation
description: External rotation performed prone with the elbow bent and upper arm supported.
instructions: Position the upper arm comfortably on a bench with the forearm able to move. Rotate the forearm upward without lifting or twisting the torso, then lower slowly.

name: Bilateral Band External Rotation
description: External rotation with both elbows at the sides and a band held between the hands.
instructions: Bend both elbows and keep them close to the torso. Spread the hands against a light band while keeping the wrists neutral, then return without flaring the ribs.

name: Shoulder External Rotation Isometric
description: A static external-rotation effort against an immovable support.
instructions: Bend the elbow beside the torso and press the back of the hand gently outward into a wall or fixed support. Keep the arm still and breathe normally before releasing the effort.

name: Cable Shoulder Internal Rotation
description: Shoulder internal rotation against a cable with the elbow beside the torso.
instructions: Set the cable at elbow height and keep the upper arm close to the body. Bring the forearm inward across the abdomen without turning the trunk, then return with control.

name: Banded Shoulder Internal Rotation
description: Shoulder internal rotation against an anchored elastic band.
instructions: Stand beside the anchor with the elbow bent against the side. Rotate the hand toward the abdomen without pulling the elbow behind you, then return slowly.

name: Cable Internal Rotation at Shoulder Height
description: Internal rotation with the upper arm held or supported near shoulder height.
instructions: Use a light load and support the upper arm if needed. Rotate the forearm forward while keeping the elbow position steady, then return without forcing the shoulder into a painful range.

name: Shoulder Internal Rotation Isometric
description: A static internal-rotation effort against a fixed support.
instructions: Bend the elbow beside the torso and press the palm inward against a stable surface or the other hand. Keep the shoulder position steady, breathe normally, and relax gradually.

name: Dumbbell Scaption
description: An arm raise in the plane slightly forward of the shoulders, usually with the thumbs up.
instructions: Hold light dumbbells with the thumbs pointing upward. Raise the arms diagonally forward and outward through a comfortable range, then lower without shrugging abruptly or swinging.

name: Barbell Curl
description: A standing elbow curl using a straight bar.
instructions: Hold the bar with comfortable wrists and keep the torso steady. Bend the elbows to lift the bar without swinging the hips, then lower through a controlled range.

name: EZ-Bar Curl
description: An elbow curl using an angled EZ-bar grip.
instructions: Select the angled grip that suits the wrists and elbows. Curl while keeping the upper arms reasonably still, then lower without bouncing or leaning backward.

name: Dumbbell Curl
description: An elbow curl with a dumbbell in each hand.
instructions: Stand or sit with the upper arms beside the torso. Curl the weights with the palms facing forward, then lower without turning the movement into a shoulder swing.

name: Alternating Dumbbell Curl
description: A dumbbell curl performed one arm at a time.
instructions: Keep both weights controlled at the sides. Curl one arm without rotating the torso, lower it smoothly, and alternate sides.

name: Hammer Curl
description: A dumbbell curl with a neutral grip throughout the movement.
instructions: Hold the dumbbells with the palms facing each other. Bend the elbows without swinging the shoulders, then lower while preserving the neutral wrist position.

name: Cross-Body Hammer Curl
description: A neutral-grip curl that brings a dumbbell toward the opposite side of the chest.
instructions: Keep the wrist neutral and bring one dumbbell diagonally across the torso. Avoid turning the whole body, then lower to the side with control.

name: Incline Dumbbell Curl
description: A dumbbell curl with the upper arms positioned behind the torso on an incline bench.
instructions: Sit back with the shoulders supported and let the arms hang. Curl without bringing the elbows far forward, then lower only through a comfortable shoulder and elbow range.

name: Preacher Curl
description: An elbow curl with the upper arms supported on a preacher pad.
instructions: Adjust the seat so the upper arms rest securely on the pad. Curl the chosen bar without lifting the shoulders, then lower without dropping into a forced elbow lockout.

name: Dumbbell Preacher Curl
description: A preacher curl using a dumbbell for one supported arm.
instructions: Rest the upper arm fully on the pad and align the wrist comfortably. Curl the dumbbell without lifting the arm away, then lower slowly through the available range.

name: Spider Curl
description: A curl performed prone against an incline bench with the arms hanging forward.
instructions: Rest the chest on the incline bench and let the arms hang below the shoulders. Curl without lifting the elbows, then lower with the chest remaining supported.

name: Concentration Curl
description: A one-arm seated curl with the elbow braced against the inner thigh.
instructions: Sit with the feet apart and support the working upper arm against the thigh. Curl without leaning the torso to assist, then lower with a controlled wrist.

name: Cable Curl
description: A standing elbow curl using a low cable.
instructions: Face the pulley with the elbows near the sides. Curl the attachment without shifting the torso, then lower while keeping tension controlled rather than letting the stack crash.

name: Bayesian Cable Curl
description: A cable curl with the upper arm slightly behind the torso.
instructions: Face away from a low pulley and let the working arm extend comfortably behind you. Keep that upper-arm position steady as you curl, then lower without overstretching the shoulder.

name: High Cable Curl
description: An elbow curl with the upper arms held out near shoulder height.
instructions: Position the cables above or beside the shoulders and keep the upper arms steady. Curl the handles inward toward the head, then extend the elbows without letting the shoulders be pulled backward.

name: Cable Hammer Curl
description: A cable curl using a neutral-grip attachment.
instructions: Hold a rope or neutral handles with the elbows beside the body. Curl without separating the wrists into an uncomfortable angle, then lower under control.

name: Reverse Curl
description: An elbow curl using an overhand grip on a bar.
instructions: Grip the bar with the palms down and keep the wrists straight. Curl with a manageable load while limiting body swing, then lower smoothly.

name: Zottman Curl
description: A dumbbell curl lifted with a supinated grip and lowered with a pronated grip.
instructions: Curl the weights with the palms up. Near the top, rotate to palms down and lower slowly, then return to the starting grip without twisting the wrists under excessive load.

name: Drag Curl
description: A barbell curl keeping the bar close to the torso as the elbows move backward.
instructions: Hold the bar at the thighs and curl it upward close to the body. Allow the elbows to travel back without shrugging, then reverse the path under control.

name: Banded Biceps Curl
description: An elbow curl against a resistance band secured beneath the feet or to a low anchor.
instructions: Check the anchor and grip the band securely. Curl while keeping the trunk still, then extend the elbows slowly without allowing the band to recoil.

name: Cable Triceps Pushdown
description: An elbow-extension exercise using a high cable attachment.
instructions: Stand near the pulley with the elbows beside the torso. Straighten the elbows while keeping the upper arms stable, then return without letting the shoulders rise or the stack drop.

name: Single-Arm Cable Triceps Pushdown
description: A one-arm pushdown using a high cable.
instructions: Set a stable stance and hold the handle with a comfortable wrist. Extend the elbow without moving the upper arm behind the torso, then return slowly.

name: Overhead Cable Triceps Extension
description: An elbow-extension exercise with the upper arms positioned overhead.
instructions: Face away from the pulley and establish a stable stance. Keep the upper arms in a comfortable overhead position as you straighten the elbows, then bend them under control.

name: Cross-Body Cable Triceps Extension
description: A one-arm cable extension with the hand moving diagonally across the front of the body.
instructions: Position the pulley so the cable follows a comfortable cross-body path. Keep the upper arm steady, extend the elbow, and return without rotating the torso or shrugging.

name: Lying EZ-Bar Triceps Extension
description: A lying elbow extension lowering an EZ-bar toward or slightly behind the head.
instructions: Lie on a bench with the bar securely gripped and elbows pointing upward. Bend the elbows through a controlled range, then straighten them without bouncing near the face.

name: Dumbbell Skull Crusher
description: A lying triceps extension using dumbbells instead of a bar.
instructions: Hold the dumbbells above the shoulders with comfortable wrists. Bend the elbows to lower the weights beside the head, then extend the arms without letting the upper arms swing excessively.

name: Overhead Dumbbell Triceps Extension
description: An overhead elbow extension holding one dumbbell with both hands.
instructions: Hold the dumbbell securely overhead and brace the trunk. Bend the elbows to lower the weight behind the head within a comfortable range, then extend without flaring the ribs.

name: Single-Arm Overhead Dumbbell Extension
description: An overhead triceps extension performed with one arm.
instructions: Support a light dumbbell overhead and stabilize the upper arm. Bend and straighten the elbow without forcing the shoulder position or arching the back.

name: Dumbbell Triceps Kickback
description: An elbow extension performed with the upper arm held behind the torso.
instructions: Hinge forward and support the body as needed. Keep the upper arm still beside the trunk, straighten the elbow, and lower without swinging the weight.

name: Cable Triceps Kickback
description: A triceps kickback using cable resistance.
